title: Denormalized annotation.tags must stay in sync with annotation_tag join table
answers: How are annotation tags stored and queried between annotation.tags and annotation_tag?
Why does Get return updated annotation tags while GetTags returns stale removed tags?
How to test that removed tags are deleted from the annotation_tag join table?
body:
Invariant: Denormalized annotation.tags column and annotation_tag join table rows must be kept in sync on all tag mutations.
Where enforced: pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go:xormRepositoryImpl.ensureTags synchronizes join table links with updated tags.
What breaks if skipped: Get reads annotation.tags directly and appears correct, but GetTags joins annotation_tag and returns stale tags for filtering.
Test placement: Integration tests in pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store_test.go:TestIntegrationAnnotations must verify annotation_tag via SQL directly because ItemDTO.Tags assertions cannot detect join table desync.
